name: session-hud
description: A card above the prompt: model, the repository, folder and branch, context and cache; the five-hour and seven-day limits with their pace; the running subagents with their type, model and effort, and the tokens they used; what the last turn sent and added, edits and errors; and, when turned on, next steps to tick and put in the prompt.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: off: the card shows the lifetime only after a model switch names it. 5m or 1h: the lifetime your sessions write, used until a model switch names one.

nextSteps.title: Next steps
nextSteps.description: After each main turn that ends in an answer, ask a fork of the session (one short reply that shares the prompt cache) for up to four next prompts, shown under the card to tick and put in the prompt box.
